option_relations.rationale: The option describes a type of cystoid macular edema, but the provided leaf specifies a cause (intraocular lens) which is not mentioned in the option.
The option describes a drug-associated uveitis with cystoid macular edema. The provided leaf specifies cystoid macular edema secondary to an intraocular lens, which is a different etiology.
The option describes drug-induced uveitis. The provided leaf specifies cystoid macular edema secondary to an intraocular lens, which is a different condition and etiology.

The option describes idiopathic uveitis with cystoid macular edema. The provided leaf specifies cystoid macular edema secondary to an intraocular lens, which implies a known etiology and is not idiopathic.
